sections.Profile:
"Swords of Fury," released by Williams in June 1988, was designed by Doug Watson and Steve Kirk. It features a medieval fantasy theme with four flippers, two ramps, and a three-ball multiball mode. The game is known for its immersive sound and music by Brian Schmidt, as well as its unique gameplay mechanics and intricate artwork.
